title: Backend plugin manifest (backend.toml)
description: Validated after TOML→JSON. A backend plugin is .seed/backends/<name>/ with this manifest and an entry executable implementing the port (research/10 §5.3–5.4). Installed plugins are pinned in .seed/backends.lock.json; the shim verifies the lock before every invocation and treats plugin output as untrusted input (§5.5).

schema_version.description: Port contract version implemented; mismatch with port.json is exit 10

entry.description: Relative path to the executable, e.g. bin/seed-backend

requires_env.description: Env vars the shim injects per-plugin; nothing else reaches the plugin environment (least privilege, §5.5)

required.description: Must implement the full REQUIRED verb set (verbs.json); a backend without it is not conformant
